title: Florence to San Gimignano: Tuscan Light
description: Florence begins beside the Arno, where Ponte Vecchio stretches between warm-toned buildings and small kayaks cross the water. Beyond the city, the view opens into the Tuscan countryside: olive trees, cypress-lined paths and the distant towers of San Gimignano. This sequence follows that change of pace, from the river and its architecture to open valleys and a quiet terrace above the hills. Eight original photographs by Elie Cohen invite a closer look at the light, texture and space of Tuscany. Music: "Bella Italia (Eigenkomposition)" by Bernhard Schürmann via Pixabay
